purpose: Research queue only. No entry is permitted to alter A/B/C map decisions, live inputs, or trading actions.

rules.title: HSI constituent breadth and constituent-weight contribution
rules.hypothesis: Cross-sectional participation and index-point contribution may describe whether an HSI move is broad or concentrated; predictive value is unproven.

source_inputs.name: HSI constituent universe and free-float weights
source_inputs.source: HKEX/Hang Seng Indexes official constituent and index factsheet release
source_inputs.vendor_requirement: Versioned historical constituent membership and effective free-float weights, including rebalance effective dates.

source_inputs.name: Constituent adjusted close/OHLCV
source_inputs.source: Licensed vendor or official exchange-endorsed historical feed
source_inputs.vendor_requirement: Survivorship-bias-free constituent prices with corporate-action treatment and session timestamps.

source_inputs.name: Index level and divisor methodology
source_inputs.source: Hang Seng Indexes methodology and official index close
source_inputs.vendor_requirement: Index divisor/capping history or an approved contribution methodology.

data_status.reason: No constituent history, historical weights, or validated adjusted-price panel is stored in this repository.

rules.missing_data_handling: If any universe, weight, price, or corporate-action field is missing for a session, emit unavailable for that session; do not backfill from a later constituent list or substitute current weights.

applicable: regular HSI cash-session close with complete point-in-time universe
disabled: rebalance-effective sessions without verified effective weights
half-day or holiday sessions until separately tested

definitions.trigger: Research candidate only: breadth z-score and concentration metric cross preregistered thresholds computed from point-in-time inputs; thresholds remain unset until training protocol is approved.
definitions.confirmation: A completed HSI cash-session observation and all required constituent inputs pass freshness/completeness checks; no intraday or partial-session confirmation.
definitions.invalidation: Any source revision, universe/weight mismatch, corporate-action ambiguity, or data-status other than available invalidates the observation.
definitions.exit: Research label ends at the next defined evaluation horizon; no position instruction or A/B/C decision is produced.

backtest.interval: Not run; must predeclare a point-in-time historical interval before retrieval.
backtest.sample_definition: Not run; sample must exclude sessions with incomplete universe/weight/price fields and report exclusions.
backtest.cost_model: Not applicable until a tradeable execution instrument and entry/exit timing are preregistered.
backtest.slippage_model: Not applicable until a tradeable execution instrument and entry/exit timing are preregistered.
backtest.walk_forward: Not run; define rolling train/validate windows before threshold selection.
backtest.holdout: Not run; reserve an untouched chronological final holdout before model selection.

rules.conflict_priority: Informational only; when unavailable, stale, or conflicting with an existing production map, it has no decision priority and cannot modify A/B/C logic.

change_log: v1: preregistered research card; no data or results claimed.

rules.title: HSI futures night session and cash-futures basis
rules.hypothesis: Overnight futures pricing and basis may describe cash-open context; predictive value is unproven.

source_inputs.name: HSI futures trade/settlement and contract metadata
source_inputs.source: HKEX official derivatives data or licensed historical vendor
source_inputs.vendor_requirement: Night-session timestamps, contract rolls, settlement, expiry, and continuous-series methodology.

data_status.reason: No validated futures history is stored.

rules.missing_data_handling: Emit unavailable; never infer night-session values from cash-index data.

applicable: verified trading night with active front contract

definitions.confirmation: Verified futures and cash timestamps under one roll convention.
definitions.invalidation: Missing or stale futures, cash, contract, or roll data.
definitions.exit: Research horizon only; no production decision.

backtest.cost_model: Not applicable until instrument is declared.
backtest.slippage_model: Not applicable until instrument is declared.

rules.conflict_priority: Informational only; no priority over production maps.

rules.title: HSI liquidity state
rules.hypothesis: Cash and derivatives liquidity conditions may constrain interpretation and execution; predictive value is unproven.

source_inputs.name: Order-book/trade liquidity measures
source_inputs.source: HKEX official market data or licensed vendor
source_inputs.vendor_requirement: Timestamped bids/asks, trades, depth, and session flags with documented coverage.

data_status.reason: No validated order-book or trade-level data is stored.

rules.missing_data_handling: Emit unavailable; do not use index turnover as a proxy for spread/depth without separate validation.

applicable: normal continuous auction with complete timestamps

definitions.invalidation: Feed gap, stale tick, session mismatch, or vendor correction.
definitions.exit: Research horizon only; no production decision.

backtest.slippage_model: Must use observed or conservatively modeled spread/impact.

rules.conflict_priority: Informational only; no priority over production maps.

rules.title: HSI options implied-volatility state
rules.hypothesis: Option-implied volatility, skew, and term structure may describe priced risk; predictive value is unproven.

source_inputs.name: HSI options quotes and contract metadata
source_inputs.source: HKEX official derivatives data or licensed options vendor
source_inputs.vendor_requirement: Timestamped bid/ask, strikes, expiries, rates/dividends convention, settlement, and stale-quote flags.

data_status.reason: No validated options surface history is stored.

rules.missing_data_handling: Emit unavailable; do not reconstruct IV from a single last trade or mix expiry conventions.

applicable: liquid strikes with validated bid/ask and time-to-expiry

definitions.confirmation: Surface passes quote-quality filters and fixed interpolation convention.
definitions.invalidation: Stale quote, invalid arbitrage checks, or convention change.
definitions.exit: Research horizon only; no production decision.

backtest.slippage_model: Must incorporate bid/ask and contract liquidity.

rules.conflict_priority: Informational only; no priority over production maps.

rules.title: HSI event calendar classification
rules.hypothesis: Predefined, timestamped macro and market events may classify event risk; predictive value is unproven.

source_inputs.name: Official event timestamps and outcome records
source_inputs.source: Primary issuer/central-bank/government/HKEX calendars, with licensed archive if necessary
source_inputs.vendor_requirement: Point-in-time scheduled/revised timestamps, timezone, expected/actual fields, and cancellation history.

data_status.reason: No point-in-time event archive is stored.

rules.missing_data_handling: Use no-trade/unknown event-risk label; never treat a later-revised calendar as a known historical schedule.

applicable: events with primary-source timestamp and outcome provenance

definitions.confirmation: Primary-source timestamp is verified; outcome data, if used, is timestamped and revision-aware.
definitions.invalidation: Cancellation, reschedule, missing provenance, or timezone ambiguity.
definitions.exit: Event window expires; no directional decision is produced.

backtest.cost_model: Not applicable for calendar-only risk label.
backtest.slippage_model: Not applicable for calendar-only risk label.

rules.conflict_priority: Risk label only; it may gate research evaluation but cannot modify production maps.

change_log: v1: data requirements recorded; no data or results claimed.
